name: Tagajō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tagajō city emblem in green: a disc crossed by diagonal white strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Tagajō, a city in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 January 1969.

features.role: Tagajō city emblem — a disc crossed by diagonal white strokes
